assumptions.choice: Session times are interpreted in the feed timestamp's New York/Eastern local time.
assumptions.reason: The specification names New York and London sessions but provides no timezone conversion rule.

assumptions.choice: Asian session is 20:00-03:00, London session is 03:00-09:00, NY opening window is 09:30-11:30, and Power Hour is 15:00-16:00.
assumptions.reason: Only the NY opening and closing windows are partially specified; exact Asian and London boundaries are otherwise silent.
The specification requires an ATR(5) threshold but does not state its value.

assumptions.choice: Each entry uses shares worth 1% of current broker equity at the signal close.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives 1% of total trading capital as the fixed sizing example but does not provide a fixed share quantity. With a 0.5% stop, this remains below the stated 0.5% capital maximum risk.

assumptions.choice: When both long and short are equally permitted in NY windows without a directional signal, long has deterministic precedence.
assumptions.reason: The stated NY time rules permit both directions but provide no condition for choosing between them; holding at most one position prevents simultaneous long and short entries.

assumptions.choice: A break below the Asian low followed by a bullish candle is long; a break above the Asian high followed by a bearish candle is short.
assumptions.reason: This is the closest OHLCV-only reading of a new Asian-range extreme followed by reversal in the opposite direction.

assumptions.choice: Asian extremes are accumulated only when Asian-session bars are present in the single supplied feed; otherwise London trades cannot be qualified from unavailable Asian data.
assumptions.reason: The supplied AAPL feed begins at 09:30, so it contains no Asian or London-session bars from which the required extremes and reversals can be observed.
